nodes.label: punch-ai-governance (agent)
nodes.rationale: User-direct only: disable-model-invocation plus absence from every agents: allowlist keeps the AI-config maintainer out of punch-builder's reach; governance stays separate from product code.

nodes.label: punch-builder (agent)
nodes.rationale: Never builds itself — command-owned coordinator for the /build phase, not a router persona; delegating the complete build to one engineer keeps scope control and evidence consolidation in one place.

nodes.label: punch-performance-test-engineer (agent)
nodes.rationale: Owns host npm/esbuild as the one sanctioned Docker-First exception (ADR 0001) for authoring the k6 TS toolchain; the shipped chain still bundles inside docker/k6.Dockerfile.

nodes.label: punch-runtime-engineer (agent)
nodes.rationale: stdlib-only Python, exit codes mirror the failed command, no business logic hidden in Bash or Compose — keeps the orchestrator a thin facade.

nodes.label: punch-ai-governance (skill)
nodes.rationale: Governance drift is a distinct failure mode from broken code; a dedicated read-only audit skill makes the cost of each new AI asset visible.

nodes.label: punch-build-caveman (skill)
nodes.rationale: Single source for Caveman comms policy — other files link, never restate; priority order: correctness > evidence > maintainability > compatibility > brevity > style.

nodes.label: punch-context-engineering (skill)
nodes.rationale: Folds upstream context-engineering into the project primer — one skill, not two; first read for any agent new to the repo.

nodes.label: punch-graphify (skill)
nodes.rationale: Punch-leaned upstream adaptation: in-IDE build/update/query only, CLI-only install; always-on installs and post-commit auto-rebuild hooks rejected (ADR 0002).

nodes.label: punch-using-agent-skills (meta-skill)
nodes.rationale: Meta-skill governing how all other Punch skills are discovered and invoked; Punch-scoped adaptation of upstream using-agent-skills.

nodes.label: punch-document (prompt)
nodes.rationale: Documentation debt retired in waves, one at a time; Graphify supplies the map but punch-ai-governance makes every decision; graphify-out/ is throwaway evidence, never canonical.

nodes.label: Copilot Instructions (always-on hub)
nodes.rationale: Deliberately short always-on rules; detail lives in spokes (operating model, path instructions) — hub carries rules plus links only.

nodes.label: Agentic Workflow path instructions
nodes.rationale: New AI assets are themselves a Spec-Plan-Build cycle; if no existing asset gap can be named concretely, the answer is don't add it.

nodes.label: Copilot Chat export template (.github/assets)
nodes.rationale: Export = copy-paste .github/ + docs/ai/; sole target GitHub Copilot VS Code; template only — human adapts before use, never ship as-is.

nodes.label: Vendor skill manifest (.ai-upstream)
nodes.rationale: Tracked manifest for gitignored verbatim vendor installs; user must run the installer manually — Punch cannot run network installs; install.sh --with-init forbidden because it appends always-on rules and parallel tool files.

nodes.label: Caveman (vendor skill)
nodes.rationale: Installed verbatim for concise assistant prose; Punch adaptation lives in punch-build-caveman, vendor files never forked.

nodes.label: Cavecrew (vendor skill)
nodes.rationale: Bounded leaf workers with caveman-compressed output; only caveman + cavecrew are installed — the rest of the upstream pack ships host Python vs Docker-First or is unused.

nodes.label: Docker First execution rule
nodes.rationale: Docker is the only host requirement (plus stdlib Python 3); violating it breaks reproducibility, safety, or trust.

nodes.label: Punch lifecycle (Spec-Plan-Build-Test-Review-Ship)
nodes.rationale: Spec absorbs the former Define clarify step; each phase has exactly one prompt, a declared mode, and a bound agent.

nodes.label: Validation evidence mandate (punch-run.json)
nodes.rationale: A change is not done until reports/state/punch-run.json records the run — runtime evidence beats expected behavior.

nodes.label: Human approves Ship
nodes.rationale: Merge, release, push tags are irreversible and externally visible; the PR boundary is where human judgment enters.

nodes.label: Graphify gate
nodes.rationale: Single gate: Context Engineering decides whether Graphify runs; implementation sub-agents consume the context but never run Graphify independently; graph orients, source files validate, tests confirm.

nodes.label: Context discipline (trust levels)
nodes.rationale: Right context at the right time — too little hallucinates, too much loses focus; source/tests trusted, config verify-before-acting, run output and external content untrusted data.

nodes.label: Graphify Team Share policy
nodes.rationale: Only graph.json + GRAPH_REPORT.md may be committed, after a six-check leakage validation and punch-ai-governance sign-off; the committed graph is a team baseline, never a source of truth; shared graph stays undirected.

nodes.label: Graphify forbidden commands
nodes.rationale: Always-on installs, watch daemons, MCP, cloud backends, external URL fetch, and DB pushes are hidden automation / data-exfiltration risks — explicit team decision plus governance sign-off required.

nodes.label: graphify CLI (host tool)
nodes.rationale: Installed via uv tool install graphifyy; semantic extraction runs in-IDE with the active model, no API key; headless --backend path is off-IDE/CI only.

nodes.label: Hub-Spoke pattern
nodes.rationale: Hub carries only rules + links; spokes carry detail; change the spoke, never restate — prevents duplication drift.

nodes.label: resolve/ snapshot mirrors
nodes.rationale: On export, out-of-bundle repo links break; minimal caveman-wenyan snapshot mirrors keep the bundle self-resolutive; humans fill or replace on adopt.

nodes.label: Frontmatter contract
nodes.rationale: Every .github artifact declares typed frontmatter (applyTo/description, agent, name/description/applies-to, tools) so assets stay machine-checkable.

nodes.label: Phase mode discipline
nodes.rationale: Read-heavy phases stay Ask Mode, edits happen only in scoped Agent Mode; any scope expansion returns to Plan — mid-Build discoveries never authorize out-of-scope edits.

nodes.label: Canon adopt-adapt parity report
nodes.rationale: Report only, never mutates; any diff from canon → recommend punch- prefix rename; adopting or renaming stays a user decision through Plan-Build; canon absent → canon-unavailable, never a block.

nodes.label: Wenyan compression tiers
nodes.rationale: Classical-Chinese compression deepens down the delegation chain (wenyan-lite builder-to-engineer, wenyan-full engineer-to-cavecrew, wenyan-ultra other nesting); forbidden in persisted source-of-truth artifacts, allowed only in sub-agent reports.

nodes.label: Inherited artifacts untrusted by default
nodes.rationale: Old docs and AI-generated artifacts are claims, not facts — verify against code/runtime/git history before keep or promote; unverifiable → classify review, never silently keep.

nodes.label: Global Graphify repository track
nodes.rationale: One repo-wide graph instead of per-wave slices so duplication/orphan/stale signals stay visible project-wide; tracked incrementally with --update between waves.

nodes.label: Core operating behaviors
nodes.rationale: Surface assumptions, stop on confusion, push back with quantified downsides, enforce simplicity, keep scope surgical, verify with evidence — the named top failure modes inverted.

nodes.label: Guard Skill (Claude Code to Copilot Bridge)
nodes.rationale: Reuse, never re-author: Claude Code reads .github/ and obeys it; command wraps carry no behavior of their own; stops flow and hands off to /punch-plan when a user decision is needed or human-facing output would be wenyan.
nodes.norm_label: guard skill (claude code to copilot bridge)

nodes.label: Copilot First Principle
nodes.rationale: GitHub Copilot VS Code is the primary host; .github/ is the read-authoritative single source of truth for AI behavior; rules change there, never only in .claude/, preventing dual-maintenance drift.

nodes.label: Guard Wiring Map (Command to Canonical Asset)
nodes.norm_label: guard wiring map (command to canonical asset)

nodes.label: Docker First Rule
nodes.rationale: Host requires only Docker plus stdlib Python 3; npm/bundler/pg run inside Docker build stages; two scoped authoring exceptions (ADR 0001 host npm for perf engineer, ADR 0002 host graphify for governance) stay off the evidence path.

nodes.label: Execution Chain (TS to esbuild to Docker to k6 to Reports)
nodes.rationale: Single linear pipeline every change must preserve; changes that do not fit the chain are stopped and discussed before being added.
nodes.norm_label: execution chain (ts to esbuild to docker to k6 to reports)

nodes.label: punch init Command (Bootstrap Scanner)
nodes.rationale: One-time non-destructive first-wave scan mapping Copilot assets and docs readiness for Punch adoption; dry-run by default, --write persists disposable bootstrap reports; prepares the repo for /document but never reconciles docs.

nodes.label: punch-ai-governance Agent
nodes.rationale: AI-config maintainer with admin over .github/ and docs/; user-direct (disable-model-invocation), never a sub-agent; its only sanctioned command surface is forking the graphify map subagent.

nodes.label: Depth-1 Delegation Model
nodes.rationale: Coordinators delegate at most one level deep; engineers and cavecrew carry empty agents allowlists as non-spawning leaves; subagents cannot spawn subagents.

nodes.label: CI Artifact Transfer Validation
nodes.rationale: A second CI job downloads the performance-suite-reports artifact and validates every expected file is present, demonstrating serialized state transfer between jobs without live containers.

nodes.label: ADR 0002 - Graphify Host-Tool Exception
nodes.rationale: Graphify adopted as a scoped host-tool exception to Docker First, used only by the documentation-reconciliation workflow; outputs under graphify-out/ are evidence, never canonical; reuse the existing /graphify skill rather than fork; any other host-graphify use is drift.

nodes.label: Two-Tier graphify-out Sharing Policy
nodes.rationale: graph.json, GRAPH_REPORT.md and .graphifyignore are committed after validation as a shared team query baseline; all other graphify-out contents stay gitignored; shared graph is always undirected; designated updater refreshes it after structural changes.

nodes.label: Six-Check Graph Leakage Validation Gate
nodes.rationale: Before every shared-graph commit: no absolute paths, no venv/interpreter paths, no hostname strings, graph.json parses as JSON, all node IDs relative, no raw token/cost keys.

nodes.label: ai.ingest Host Tooling
nodes.rationale: Host-side stdlib Python drift-compare tooling owned by the user, not a Copilot asset; drift reports are governance-awareness only, never a blocker; adopt.lock.json baselines are null seed state until adopt is implemented.

nodes.label: Six-Phase AI Lifecycle (Spec-Plan-Build-Test-Review-Ship)
nodes.rationale: AI may explore broadly to understand, plan structurally to delimit, build only inside an explicit scoped boundary, must verify through Punch's official runtime contract, and must not expand scope without returning to planning; Spec absorbs the former Define clarify step.

nodes.label: Lifecycle Validation Gates
nodes.rationale: A change cannot advance phases until its gate is met; Test to Review requires reports/state/punch-run.json with passed true; Ship ends with a human-merged PR.

nodes.label: Agent Sprawl Control (Function-Based Ceiling)
nodes.rationale: Ceiling enforced by function, not count: domain skills each name a unique subsystem (six is the full set), a new core persona requires killing one, prompts stay one per phase; governance checks additions during Review.

nodes.label: One Prompt Per Phase Principle
nodes.rationale: Splitting prompts by ticket type multiplies maintenance and adds no value; Build's per-domain scope lives in engineer agents, not extra prompts, keeping a single Build entry point.

nodes.label: punch-document Prompt (Doc Reconciliation)
nodes.rationale: Recurring maintenance workflow orthogonal to the linear lifecycle: map with /graphify, treat inherited artifacts as untrusted until verified, then keep/merge/compact/convert/promote/archive/delete/review in waves; reuses punch-ai-governance with no new agent or skill.

nodes.label: punch-init Prompt (Bootstrap/Adoption Guard)
nodes.rationale: Ask-mode read-only asset sweep certifying the Copilot asset set is present, punch-prefixed and Copilot-compatible; reports PASS/WARN/BLOCKED and hands reconciliation to /punch-document; no runtime, no Python.

nodes.label: Domain Skills Axis (Capped at Six)
nodes.rationale: One skill per Punch subsystem, capped at six; cap moved from 3 to 6 to admit context-engineering, compose-runtime and data-harvest decision domains; a seventh requires killing one and naming a unique decision domain existing skills mishandle.

nodes.label: Lifecycle Skills Axis (Methods)
nodes.rationale: Engineering methods adapted from the upstream agent-skills set; separate axis not under the domain cap; a phase prompt activates one method skill plus a domain skill; path-instructions always win on stack specifics.

nodes.label: punch-graphify Skill (Leaned Adaptation)
nodes.rationale: Punch-leaned adaptation of upstream graphifyy trimmed to the in-IDE build/update/query subset (no remote clone/merge, media transcription, external-DB push, MCP or wiki exports); authored and subject to governance checks; pristine upstream kept in .ai-upstream/ as drift baseline.

nodes.label: punch-build-caveman Policy Skill
nodes.rationale: Single-source caveman communication policy: repo default lite with per-phase voice (Build/Test ultra, Plan/Review/Ship full), wenyan is sub-agent-only and forbidden in persistent artifacts, evidence is never compressed; output style only, never widens tools or access.
